finance.guide.page.1:
Finance Guide

Ledger and transfers
Use the ledger for balances and recent records. Use /pay to transfer.
finance.guide.page.2:
Market Terminal

View commodity prices, changes, and daily opportunities.
finance.guide.page.3:
Warehousing

Deposit real items. Custody locked by sell orders cannot be withdrawn.
finance.guide.page.4:
Contracts

Accept and deliver procurement contracts at a warehouse. Rewards are escrowed.
finance.guide.page.5:
Companies

Use desks for members and facilities. Member permission is not voting power.
finance.guide.page.6:
Banking

Use counters for deposits and company loans. Public views hide private ledgers.
finance.guide.page.7:
Advanced Finance

Securities terminals provide stocks, bonds, funds, futures, insurance, and charts.
finance.guide.page.8:
Administrator Tools

The central-bank console is restricted to policy, diagnostics, and risky operations.
